notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Godo or Fear of Missing Out must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
description:
Declare either Godo or Fear of Missing Out and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Godo or Fear of Missing Out trigger.
Resolve the Godo or Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Godo or Fear of Missing Out from the battlefield, and then returning Godo or Fear of Missing Out from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.
